d: The stage of the Alcazar of St. Etienne, seen laterally. A good half of the scene on the left represents the dressing room of Zazà. - On the right of the scene, on the front, a table with various chairs for the assiduous concert that have free access to the scene. - In the corner, always on the front to the right, the door that gives in the showroom. - On the right side of the scene near the scene is occupied longitudinally by the backdrop that by means of a door gives on the scene of the coffee-concert. - In the face of this door, even in a longitudinal sense, is the holster that masks the audience that is supposed to be in the concert coffee room, the inside of the stage. - The bottom of the scene that represents the other side wall of the stage, is space of the scene, rolled scenes, gymnastics objects, etc. - In the chamber of Zazà, in which you enter through a door located in the middle of the scene, almost suspended on the table, are two or three seats; the walls, the wardrops, the wardrobes, the wardrobes,

The living room in the house of Zazà. - Parapeted scene: on the left fireplace with a mirror on top, a clock, a service for cognac, photographs, etc.; on the bell of the clock will be placed a Zazà hat. Immediately after the fireplace a door leading inside the apartment; then on the wall in Isbieco a door that gives in a toilet of riding; from the open door you can see a mantle holder with clothes, and on the ground of the boxes of hats. On the back wall, in the middle a window that gives on the street; on the left of the window a toilet table; on the right a vertical piano. On the right, at the bottom of the island, the door that gives in the anteroom; put a screen; near the wind screen a chaise-longue and on the left a table. Here and there chairs. modest furniture. It is full day. Milio is half decked on the chaise-logue, Zazà is near him, standing, with a kneeling on his knee.

The living room of Milio Dufresne in Paris, on the shore of Mazzarino: elegant furniture; grand piano in the middle with keyboard towards the bottom of the scene; armchairs, causeuses, sofas in turn; on the right window that gives towards the Seine; before the elegant window desk, on which, among other cards, it will be a letter with a torn envelope; at the bottom, in the middle, door that gives in the anteroom; another door to the left that gives in the apartments.
Zazà's living room as in the second act. Anaide sitting at the table. - Malardot restless standing next to her.
